svg.title: Edit cover: the band, tile by tile
svg.desc: Edit cover turns the album editor's cover band into the arranger, in place. A toolbar holds the presets, Close gaps, the Wide and Phone views (the phone's worked out until Arrange for phones), Use automatic cover and Done. The band shows at its real width over a faint grid of square cells. The chosen tile has handles that resize it by whole cells. Dropping a tile on one of the same size swaps them; otherwise the tiles below are pushed down. A hole is hatched and warned about, not refused. A live region reads each move aloud as columns and rows. Below the band, the tile bar holds the chosen tile's keys and options: how it's shown, its own focus, Play in the band, Hide on phones and Remove from cover. Below that, the album's items stay in their grid as the tray: those in the cover are marked, an item dragged up joins the cover, and a tile dragged down leaves it.

g.text: Presets · Close gaps · Wide | Phone · Use automatic cover · Done
Read aloud: columns 7 to 12, rows 1 to 2
Arrows move · Shift+arrows resize · Fill or Fit · Own focus · Play · Hide on phones · Remove
Drag an item up to add it to the cover, a tile down to take it out

svg.text: Every change saves, shows at once and can be undone.
